title: Apple iPhone 15 Pro

working: Positive responses describe aspects such as best
Positive responses describe aspects such as fast
Positive responses describe aspects such as worth it

summary: Over coffee, I've been thinking about this new gadget and what people are saying about it. A lot of folks seem to really enjoy how fast it is – it's got some serious speed to it. They're also saying it's worth it, which is a big deal for a lot of people who are used to paying a premium for similar products. Some viewers feel the story behind the gadget drags in parts, but others don't think that's a big issue. There's also a lot of appreciation for how well it's put together – it's one of those things that feels like it's been thought out really carefully. A few people have mentioned that it's the best in its class, but that's not a universal opinion by any means. I've seen some people mention that it's not the cheapest option out there, but they're willing to pay a bit more for the quality they're getting. It's not a deal-breaker for most people, but it's definitely something to consider if you're on a tight budget.
